query_analysis.original_query: We're working on a cryogenic separation process and experiencing fluctuations in the column's feed temperature. How can we implement an advanced control strategy to stabilize it?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Design an advanced temperature control strategy to mitigate feed temperature variations in a cryogenic separation column, focusing on stabilization and precision control mechanisms

selected_agents.role: Temperature profile analysis and thermal dynamics assessment

communication_strategy.information_flow: Iterative control mechanism refinement and thermal stability optimization
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Integrated feedback loop with continuous performance monitoring
